name: Jason Dulin
headline: Director - Professional Services
about:
Litera benefits from over eight years of leadership experience in professional services, with a focus on fostering operational excellence and customer success. As Director of Professional Services, efforts center on overseeing global service delivery for cloud and on-premises products, leading cross-functional initiatives, and building scalable processes to ensure consistent outcomes. The team is empowered through a culture of accountability and continuous improvement. 

Previous roles at Prosperoware involved directing global teams and enhancing operational efficiency through streamlined workflows and strategic staffing. Expertise in project management, change management, and service operations supports a mission to drive adoption, accelerate time-to-value, and ensure quality delivery at scale.
… more

experiences.description:
Oversee the end-to-end service delivery for a portfolio of Litera’s cloud and on-premises products, including product implementations, project and change management, customer onboarding, and partner support.
•	Led strategic, cross-functional initiatives that drove customer adoption, accelerated time-to-value, and ensured consistent service excellence across global operations.
•	Built and scaled a high-performing, self-directed team by developing managers and ICs, cultivating a culture of accountability, innovation, and continuous improvement.
•	Defined and enforced Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) to ensure quality, consistency, and operational efficiency across all service engagements.
•	Partnered with Sales, Product, and Executive Leadership to align delivery strategy with business goals and strategic accounts, enhancing customer satisfaction and retention.
•	Managed global resource planning and budget alignment, optimizing delivery capacity while staying within financial targets.
•	Developed and launched new service offerings to support evolving client needs and accelerate organizational growth.
•	Championed Litera’s Partner Program, overseeing onboarding, enablement, and ongoing partner support initiatives.
•	Led successful integration efforts during M&A activities, ensuring seamless transition of acquired teams and clients into the existing services structure.
•	Consistently met or exceeded performance KPIs, including CSAT, NPS, revenue forecasting accuracy, process compliance, and delivery timelines.

Reported directly to the CTO with responsibility for identifying strategic opportunities and risks essential to the successful delivery of Prosperoware’s software products, implementation services, consulting engagements, and customer support operations.
•	Led a global services team of Project Managers, Business Analysts, and Technical Consultants across the US, UK, India, and Kosovo, including hiring, team development, performance reviews, workload balancing, and strategic staffing.
•	Improved operational efficiency by identifying process bottlenecks and designing streamlined workflows to enhance service delivery and internal coordination.
•	Served as an executive escalation point for customer issues, ensuring timely resolution and driving overall customer satisfaction and success.
•	Collaborated with Engineering, Sales, and Product Management to prioritize and communicate customer-driven product enhancements and feature requests.
•	Supported pre-sales efforts by assisting Account Executives in product demonstrations, scoping engagements, and developing Statements of Work (SOWs) for implementations and consulting projects.
•	Oversaw relationships with third-party implementation partners; ensured proper training on product features, implementation methodologies, and service delivery standards.
•	Championed innovation by proactively identifying opportunities for product improvement and procedural optimization to support business goals and long-term success.

•	Planned, organized, and managed project resources and activities to ensure successful execution and delivery of customer-focused initiatives.
•	Developed and maintained comprehensive project plans, including task assignments, timelines, milestones, and deliverables to drive alignment and accountability.
•	Collaborated cross-functionally with department leaders to coordinate efforts, monitor progress, and proactively identify and resolve project risks and issues.
•	Delegated tasks to team members, provided oversight and support, and ensured high-quality execution across all project phases.
•	Acted as a primary point of contact for clients, addressing concerns and facilitating timely resolution of project-related inquiries or escalations.

Leader of the Operations and Design departments for the Community Magazine.  Support all editorial production for US, UK, Spain and India. Also work with our information technology group to develop and deploy solutions that support our editorial team.
Project Management

•	Drove a global VMWare solution to solve file transfer and latency issues in the various countries that our operations are based in. 
•	Managed global software deployments and upgrades to our production system.
•	Helped to define requirements for a new production platform to be rolled in late 2014.
•	Ran pilot for a new advert production process to create a better customer experience and reduce production cycle times.
Operations Management
•	Managed operation and design team with 7 direct reports.
•	Produced daily production reports for leadership to manage team’s outputs.
•	Maintained database and production schedule for 700 monthly editions.
•	Created and managed user accounts and access in several production system.
•	Created and maintained intranet and SharePoint sites to disseminate information to the team.
•	Developed workflows for editorial and pagination groups to eliminate waste in the process.
•	Worked with off -shore teams  to assist with magazine content production.
.

•	Set up processes to ensure on-boarding activities were completed for all team members that included equipment and training in US, UK, and Spain.
•	Managed workforce and capacity planning for the production of magazine product.
•	Sourced staffing vendor to hire contract employees for several skill sets for our editorial process.
